item.title: Korean BBQ Bites
item.description: Bite-sized chicken or fish, deep fried then tossed in a glossy Korean sauce (sweet heat and savory), finished with toasted sesame seeds and chives.

item.title: Wings
item.description: 10 wings seasoned, deep fried, and sautéed with your choice of signature flavor: Buffalo Blue, Scotch Bonnet, Honey Garlic, Honey Mustard, Szechuan, or Jerk.

item.title: Open Face Wantons
item.description: Six crispy fried wonton skins loaded with your choice of chicken, shrimp, or veggie, sautéed with sweet pepper, onions, and mushrooms, served with zesty soy sauce. Not available for takeout.

item.title: Cajun Hot Potatoes
item.description: Deep fried until crispy, tossed in butter and Cajun spices for a mild, flavorful bite. Served with signature sauce.

item.title: Mac and Cheese Croquettes
item.description: Crispy croquettes filled with creamy mac and cheese.

item.title: Shrimp Tempura
item.description: Six golden fried shrimp with citrus fusion sauce.

item.title: Bruschetta
item.description: Six toasted bread rounds topped with fresh tomatoes, garlic, olive oil, and basil.

item.title: Ceviche Shot
item.description: Fresh seafood marinated in citrus, served in a mini glass with lime wedges.

item.title: Garlic Bread
item.description: Six golden toasted bread brushed with garlic butter and fresh herbs.

item.title: Gyoza Dumplings
item.description: Eight pan-seared dumplings filled with savory meat and vegetables, with soy dipping sauce.

item.title: Quesadillas
item.description: Crispy outside, stuffed with melted cheese and your choice of chicken, veggie, or beef. Served with guacamole and sour cream.

item.title: Tacos
item.description: Three soft tortillas with seasoned protein, fresh veggies, and sauce, with Mexican cheese, sriracha, and guacamole.

item.title: Vietnamese Spring Roll
item.description: Fresh rice paper rolls with crisp vegetables, herbs, and your choice of protein, with dipping sauce.

item.title: Bliss Parmesan Fries
item.description: Crispy fries tossed in truffle oil with vegetables, freshly grated Parmesan, and bacon.

item.title: Golden Forest
item.description: Crispy mushrooms and broccoli, fried then sautéed with fragrant herbs. Served with garlic sauce.
